author: Corridor Crew
description:
WETA FX created a simulation tool to rule them all!

Joe Letteri, Senior VFX Supervisor at Weta FX, explains how WETA FX developed LOKI, their in-house simulation tool that unifies processes that would otherwise run across different simulation systems. This allows them to do things that were never possible before in the world of CG.
title: One SIM Tool to RULE Them All
